turns.text: Interesting question! In many Western cultures, being blunt about someone losing all their hair would likely be seen as extremely rude and insensitive. It’s generally important to be mindful of others’ feelings and to offer positive or at least neutral feedback. Cultural norms around directness and feedback vary widely; what might be acceptable in one context could be deeply offensive in another.
